notes.title: GhostGame Winter Update
notes.content:

notes.title: GhostGame 1.6 - The Local Co-op Update!!!
notes.content:
Local co-op has been added!! Control player 2 with WASD or a controller, and unlock brand new skills and synergies for them! Fight bosses together, protect each other and travel through the zones. Together you could be unstoppable! 

Also featuring many major bug fixes and improvements!
- Completely revamped the save system
- Added Steam Cloud support!
- Blooprints no longer fail to load!
- Added new costume for beating the game in hard mode
- Various improvements to skills

New Stuff!
- New skills and synergies for player 2 to explore!
- Shortened the length of all zones!! BUT Difficulty now ramps up faster!
- Some costumes have special abilities!
- Synergies between player 1 and player 2 skills!

Good luck out there!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34389684/51ff3642674ce0afb2a95a68889b7fa4d50c5a6c.png[/img]
[i]Introducing Punchy[/i]

notes.title: GhostGame v1.1
notes.content:
GhostGame v1.1 is out now!!

This update brings with it improvements, bugfixes, and a whole new zone! Unlock through clearing zone 1 three times. 

Adds
- New zone!
- New boss and enemies
- Some costumes now affect gameplay!
- New blooprints
- New achievements

Bugfixes
- fixed Hud not snapping back to normal size after being stretched
- fixed friends being able to kill you
- fixed some achievements not working
- made blooprints page clearer
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34389684/c944ece8172cafa67e083d92e1a03e634b198b9c.gif[/img]

notes.title: GhostGame v1.0.1 Patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Firstly, a huge thank you to everyone reading this! GhostGame's release is off to a slow start, but I'm thankful that people are still playing and enjoying it, and also I'm just happy to have a Steam release under my belt regardless.

I'm excited to pump out more and more updates and content as GhostGame builds traction!


[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new achievement for completing the game in hard mode
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a Blooprints - locking up glitch
[*] Fixed Costume disappearing bug
[/list]

Thank you all again for the support!
